test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held On: 30 June, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Persuesive'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Among the given options the incorrectly spelled word is **'Persuesive'.**
 
• The correct spelling is **'Persuasive'.**
 
• **Persuasive:** It means being able to cause people to do or believe something. (प्रेरक)
 
 
• **Example:** *The scientist presented a **persuasive** example of the existence of life on Mars.*
 
 
 
• Hence, the incorrectly spelled word is **'Persuasive'.**

Therefore, the correct answer is **'Option 4'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Violence:** It refers to behavior that harms or damages somebody/something physically. (हिंसा)

 
 
• Example: The viewers complain that there is too much **violence** in the movie.
 
 
 
• **Tyranny:** It refers to the cruel and unfair use of power by a person or small group to control a country or state. (अत्‍याचार)
 
 
• Example: The judge removed the children from their home because of their mother’s **tyranny.**
 
 
 
• **Valorous:** It means possessing or displaying courage, or being able to face and deal with danger or fear without fear. (वीरतापूर्ण)
 
 
• Example: His **valorous** performance is an example of the fighting spirit of the Indian Army.
